title: East Nashville Cozy and Convenient - Spring Fun!
description:
Fall is calling in East Nashville, and this Douglas Ave retreat puts you close to it all. Explore local coffee shops, live music, neighborhood bars, and dining just minutes away. Inside, clean modern design and open living spaces offer a comfortable place to recharge after a day of concerts, great food, and Music City adventures.

The space
One of the most centrally located houses in East Nashville, this place is less than 3 blocks to Publix, Starbucks, Once Upon A Time In France, Pearl Diver, The Wash, Corner Deli, and much more! This home is super walkable and has a surprisingly private feel. 

Fully furnished and designed with your experience in mind, our home is the perfect place to rest after a day of exploration or stay in with loved ones to enjoy vibrant comfort and an outdoor spacious backyard.

Fenced in yard with great off-street parking

**Please note**  

Pets allowed with an additional $40 charge. Maximum of 2 pets.

No parties allowed. We discourage Nashville locals from booking with this intent.
